en: A black-and-white photograph depicting a broad, empty street or square bordered by mature trees and two-story European-style buildings with tile roofs. On the left, an older stone building—possibly a church—can be seen, with a steeple in the background. There is a tall industrial chimney in the middle ground and several people and a horse-drawn cart are visible further along the street. The style of the scene suggests a small town in Central or Eastern Europe in the early 20th century.
